Belum ada dokumen

📦 Master Data

Format mengikuti master SAP (Kode, Deskripsi, Satuan, Material Group, Kategori, Paket Pengadaan). Dipakai untuk auto-isi form dokumen. Klik ✏️ Edit (atau klik dua kali baris) untuk memperbaiki data.

Import Master Data dari Excel

1. Pilih file Excel export SAP (master service / material / rekanan vendor).

2. Jenis data, sheet, baris judul, dan kolom dipilih otomatis — cek contoh data di bawah, ubah bila perlu.

3. Klik "Import". Data dengan kode yang sama akan diperbarui.

⬆️ Pembaruan Aplikasi

1. Unduh file paket pembaruan-x.y.z.json yang dikirim.

2. Klik "Pilih Paket Pembaruan" lalu pilih file tersebut.

3. Aplikasi dimuat ulang dengan versi baru. Data dokumen & master tidak berubah; file di folder tidak perlu diganti.

// ===== Format helpers =====
function formatIdp(amount) {
  const num = Number(amount);
  if (!isFinite(num)) return 'Rp 0';
  return 'Rp ' + Math.round(num).toLocaleString('id-ID');
}

function formatNum(n) {
  const num = Number(n);
  if (!isFinite(num)) return '0';
  return num.toLocaleString('id-ID', { maximumFractionDigits: 3 });
}

function pad(n, len = 2) { return String(n).padStart(len, '0'); }

function todayStr() {
  const d = new Date();
  return d.getFullYear() + '-' + pad(d.getMonth() + 1) + '-' + pad(d.getDate());
}

function formatDateStr(dateStr) {
  if (!dateStr) return '—';
  const d = new Date(dateStr + 'T00:00:00');
  if (isNaN(d)) return dateStr;
  return d.toLocaleDateString('id-ID', { year: 'numeric', month: 'long', day: 'numeric' });
}

function formatDateTime(ts) {
  if (!ts) return '—';
  const d = new Date(ts);
  return d.toLocaleDateString('id-ID', { year: 'numeric', month: 'short', day: 'numeric', hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
}

function escapeHtml(text) {
  if (text === undefined || text === null) return '';
  return String(text).replace(/&/g, '&').replace(/</g, '<').replace(/>/g, '>')
    .replace(/"/g, '"').replace(/'/g, ''');
}

function getStatusBadge(status) {
  const map = { 'Draft': 'badge-draft', 'Dibuat': 'badge-dibuat', 'Dipublikasikan': 'badge-publikasi', 'Selesai': 'badge-selesai' };
  return map[status] || 'badge-draft';
}

function getCategoryLabel(cat) {
  const map = { 'Subkon': 'Subkontraktor', 'Bahan': 'Bahan', 'Alat': 'Alat & Perlengkapan' };
  return map[cat] || cat || '—';
}

function getDocType(code) {
  return DOC_TYPES.find(t => t.code === code) || { code, label: code, title: String(code || 'DOKUMEN').toUpperCase() };
}

function toRoman(n) {
  return ['', 'I', 'II', 'III', 'IV', 'V', 'VI', 'VII', 'VIII', 'IX', 'X', 'XI', 'XII'][n] || '';
}

function terbilang(n) {
  n = Math.floor(Math.abs(Number(n) || 0));
  const s = ['', 'satu', 'dua', 'tiga', 'empat', 'lima', 'enam', 'tujuh', 'delapan', 'sembilan', 'sepuluh', 'sebelas'];
  const t = (x) => {
    if (x < 12) return s[x];
    if (x < 20) return t(x - 10) + ' belas';
    if (x < 100) return t(Math.floor(x / 10)) + ' puluh ' + t(x % 10);
    if (x < 200) return 'seratus ' + t(x - 100);
    if (x < 1000) return t(Math.floor(x / 100)) + ' ratus ' + t(x % 100);
    if (x < 2000) return 'seribu ' + t(x - 1000);
    if (x < 1e6) return t(Math.floor(x / 1000)) + ' ribu ' + t(x % 1000);
    if (x < 1e9) return t(Math.floor(x / 1e6)) + ' juta ' + t(x % 1e6);
    if (x < 1e12) return t(Math.floor(x / 1e9)) + ' miliar ' + t(x % 1e9);
    return t(Math.floor(x / 1e12)) + ' triliun ' + t(x % 1e12);
  };
  if (n === 0) return 'nol';
  return t(n).replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
}

function capitalize(str) { return str.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + str.slice(1); }

function genId(prefix) {
  return prefix + Date.now().toString(36) + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 7);
}

function showToast(msg, type = 'ok') {
  const el = $('#toast');
  el.textContent = msg;
  el.className = 'toast show ' + (type === 'error' ? 'toast-error' : '');
  clearTimeout(showToast.timer);
  showToast.timer = setTimeout(() => { el.className = 'toast'; }, 3000);
}

// ===== Storage (IndexedDB) =====
const DB_NAME = 'JICT_Priuk_DB';
const DB_VERSION = 4;
const STORE = 'documents';
const OLD_MASTER_STORE = 'masterData';
const ITEM_STORE = 'masterItems';
const SETTINGS_STORE = 'settings';
let dbPromise = null;

function openDB() {
  if (dbPromise) return dbPromise;
  dbPromise = new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const req = indexedDB.open(DB_NAME, DB_VERSION);
    req.onupgradeneeded = () => {
      const db = req.result;
      if (!db.objectStoreNames.contains(STORE)) db.createObjectStore(STORE, { keyPath: 'id' });
      if (!db.objectStoreNames.contains(SETTINGS_STORE)) db.createObjectStore(SETTINGS_STORE);
      // v4: menu Bahan / Alat / Subkon — kontrak induk & berita acara per termin
      if (!db.objectStoreNames.contains('kontrak')) db.createObjectStore('kontrak', { keyPath: 'id' }).createIndex('menu', 'menu');
      if (!db.objectStoreNames.contains('termin')) db.createObjectStore('termin', { keyPath: 'id' }).createIndex('kontrakId', 'kontrakId');
      if (!db.objectStoreNames.contains(ITEM_STORE)) {
        const items = db.createObjectStore(ITEM_STORE, { keyPath: 'uid' });
        items.createIndex('type', 'type');
        // Pindahkan master versi lama (satu record besar) ke store per-item
        if (db.objectStoreNames.contains(OLD_MASTER_STORE)) {
          const r = req.transaction.objectStore(OLD_MASTER_STORE).get('master');
          r.onsuccess = () => {
            const m = r.result || {};
            ['vendors', 'materials', 'services'].forEach(type => {
              (m[type] || []).filter(x => x && x.name).forEach(x => {
                items.put(toDbItem(makeMasterItem(type, { ...x, price: x.price ?? x.haran ?? x.estimateRate ?? '' })));
              });
            });
            db.deleteObjectStore(OLD_MASTER_STORE);
          };
        }
      }
    };
    req.onsuccess = () => {
      const db = req.result;
      db.onversionchange = () => { db.close(); dbPromise = null; };
      resolve(db);
    };
    req.onerror = () => reject(req.error);
    req.onblocked = () => alert('Tutup tab lain aplikasi ini lalu muat ulang halaman.');
  });
  return dbPromise;
}

async function dbRequest(storeName, mode, fn) {
  const db = await openDB();
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const tx = db.transaction(storeName, mode);
    const req = fn(tx.objectStore(storeName));
    let result;
    if (req) req.onsuccess = () => { result = req.result; };
    tx.oncomplete = () => resolve(result);
    tx.onerror = () => reject(tx.error || req?.error);
    tx.onabort = () => reject(tx.error || new Error('Transaksi dibatalkan (kemungkinan penyimpanan penuh)'));
  });
}

const dbGetAll = () => dbRequest(STORE, 'readonly', s => s.getAll());
const dbPut = (doc) => dbRequest(STORE, 'readwrite', s => s.put(doc));
const dbDelete = (id) => dbRequest(STORE, 'readwrite', s => s.delete(id));
const dbGetSettings = () => dbRequest(SETTINGS_STORE, 'readonly', s => s.get('app'));
const dbPutSettings = (v) => dbRequest(SETTINGS_STORE, 'readwrite', s => s.put(v, 'app'));
const dbGetMasterItems = () => dbRequest(ITEM_STORE, 'readonly', s => s.getAll());
const dbPutMasterItems = (items) => dbRequest(ITEM_STORE, 'readwrite', s => { items.forEach(it => s.put(toDbItem(it))); });
const dbDeleteMasterItems = (uids) => dbRequest(ITEM_STORE, 'readwrite', s => { uids.forEach(u => s.delete(u)); });

// ===== Normalisasi data lama =====
function normalizeDoc(d) {
  if (!Array.isArray(d.items)) {
    d.items = [];
    if (d.itemDescription || d.unitPrice || d.itemQty) {
      d.items.push({ desc: d.itemDescription || '', unit: '', qty: Number(d.itemQty) || 0, price: Number(d.unitPrice) || 0 });
    }
  }
  if (!Array.isArray(d.updates)) d.updates = [];
  if (d.ppnRate === undefined) d.ppnRate = 11;
  return d;
}

// Bentuk item master baku: hanya field yang dikenal + type + uid
function makeMasterItem(type, src) {
  const item = { type, uid: src.uid || `${type}:${src.code ? String(src.code).trim() : genId('m')}` };
  MASTER_FIELDS[type].forEach(f => {
    let v = src[f.key];
    if (f.type === 'number') v = (v === '' || v === null || v === undefined || !isFinite(Number(v))) ? '' : Number(v);
    else v = v === null || v === undefined ? '' : String(v).trim();
    item[f.key] = v;
  });
  return item;
}

// Kolom bantu pencarian (_s) hanya di memori, tidak disimpan
function toDbItem(it) {
  const { _s, ...rest } = it;
  return rest;
}

function searchText(it) {
  if (!it._s) it._s = MASTER_FIELDS[it.type].map(f => it[f.key]).join(' ').toLowerCase();
  return it._s;
}

function vendorAddress(v) {
  return [v.address, v.houseNo ? 'No. ' + v.houseNo : '', v.city, v.postCode && v.postCode !== '99999' ? v.postCode : '']
    .filter(Boolean).join(', ');
}

function docTotals(doc) {
  const sub = (doc.items || []).reduce((s, it) => s + (Number(it.qty) || 0) * (Number(it.price) || 0), 0);
  const ppn = doc.ppnOn ? Math.round(sub * (Number(doc.ppnRate) || 0) / 100) : 0;
  return { sub, ppn, total: sub + ppn };
}

function applyFilters() {
  const search = $('#searchInput').value.trim().toLowerCase();
  const project = $('#filterProject').value;
  const category = $('#filterCategory').value;
  const type = $('#filterType').value;
  const status = $('#filterStatus').value;
  const dateFrom = $('#filterDateFrom').value;
  const dateTo = $('#filterDateTo').value;
  const updateSearch = $('#filterUpdateSearch').value.trim().toLowerCase();
  const sortBy = $('#sortBy').value;

  filteredDocs = documents.filter(d => {
    if (project !== 'all' && d.project !== project) return false;
    if (category !== 'all' && d.category !== category) return false;
    if (type !== 'all' && d.docType !== type) return false;
    if (status !== 'all' && d.status !== status) return false;
    if (dateFrom && (d.contractDate || '') < dateFrom) return false;
    if (dateTo && (d.contractDate || '') > dateTo) return false;
    if (search) {
      const hay = [d.docNo, d.refNo, d.project, d.vendor, d.docType, getDocType(d.docType).label, d.npwp, d.notes,
        ...(d.items || []).map(i => i.desc)].join(' ').toLowerCase();
      if (!hay.includes(search)) return false;
    }
    if (updateSearch) {
      const ok = (d.updates || []).some(u =>
        [u.description, u.party, u.notes, u.date].join(' ').toLowerCase().includes(updateSearch));
      if (!ok) return false;
    }
    return true;
  });

  const sorters = {
    dateDesc: (a, b) => (b.contractDate || '').localeCompare(a.contractDate || '') || (b.createdAt - a.createdAt),
    dateAsc: (a, b) => (a.contractDate || '').localeCompare(b.contractDate || '') || (a.createdAt - b.createdAt),
    valueDesc: (a, b) => docTotals(b).total - docTotals(a).total,
    updated: (a, b) => (b.updatedAt || 0) - (a.updatedAt || 0),
  };
  filteredDocs.sort(sorters[sortBy] || sorters.dateDesc);

  $('#totalCount').textContent = filteredDocs.length;
  $('#totalAmount').textContent = formatIdp(filteredDocs.reduce((s, d) => s + docTotals(d).total, 0));
  $('#pendingCount').textContent = filteredDocs.filter(d => d.status !== 'Selesai').length;
  $('#vendorCount').textContent = new Set(filteredDocs.map(d => (d.vendor || '').trim().toLowerCase()).filter(Boolean)).size;

  const grid = $('#docGrid');
  if (filteredDocs.length === 0) {
    grid.innerHTML = '';
    $('#emptyState').style.display = 'block';
    const noDocs = documents.length === 0;
    $('#emptyTitle').textContent = noDocs ? 'Belum ada dokumen' : 'Tidak ada dokumen yang cocok';
    $('#emptyDesc').textContent = noDocs
      ? 'Silakan buat dokumen pertama Anda. Format mengikuti template baku JICT Priuk.'
      : 'Ubah kata kunci atau klik Reset pada filter.';
    return;
  }
  $('#emptyState').style.display = 'none';
  grid.innerHTML = filteredDocs.map(renderCard).join('');
}

// ===== Auto-saran dari master (cepat untuk puluhan ribu data) =====
const ac = { input: null, results: [], idx: 0, timer: null };

function acSources(kind) {
  if (kind === 'vendor') return [masterData.vendors];
  const cat = $('#docCategory').value;
  if (cat === 'Subkon') return [masterData.services, masterData.materials];
  return [masterData.materials, masterData.services];
}

function acSearch(kind, q, limit = 30) {
  const tokens = q.toLowerCase().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
  if (!tokens.length) return [];
  const exact = [], starts = [], other = [];
  for (const list of acSources(kind)) {
    for (const it of list) {
      const s = searchText(it);
      if (!tokens.every(t => s.includes(t))) continue;
      const name = (it.name || '').toLowerCase();
      if (it.code === q.trim() || name === q.trim().toLowerCase()) exact.push(it);
      else if (name.startsWith(tokens[0])) starts.push(it);
      else other.push(it);
      if (exact.length + starts.length >= limit) break;
    }
    if (exact.length + starts.length >= limit) break;
  }
  return [...exact, ...starts, ...other].slice(0, limit);
}

function acRender() {
  const box = $('#acBox');
  if (!ac.input || !ac.results.length) { box.style.display = 'none'; return; }
  const r = ac.input.getBoundingClientRect();
  box.style.left = r.left + 'px';
  box.style.top = (r.bottom + 2) + 'px';
  box.style.width = Math.max(r.width, 420) + 'px';
  box.innerHTML = ac.results.map((it, i) => {
    const tag = { vendors: 'VDR', materials: 'MAT', services: 'SRV' }[it.type];
    const meta = it.type === 'vendors'
      ? [it.code, it.city, it.category].filter(Boolean).join(' · ')
      : [it.code, it.unit, it.group, it.price ? formatIdp(it.price) : ''].filter(Boolean).join(' · ');
    return `<div class="ac-item ${i === ac.idx ? 'active' : ''}" data-i="${i}">
      <span class="ac-tag ac-${it.type}">${tag}</span>
      <div><div class="ac-name">${escapeHtml(it.name)}${it.block === 'X' ? ' <span class="ac-block">DIBLOKIR</span>' : ''}</div>
      <div class="ac-meta">${escapeHtml(meta)}</div></div></div>`;
  }).join('');
  box.style.display = 'block';
  box.querySelector('.ac-item.active')?.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest' });
}

function acClose() {
  ac.input = null; ac.results = [];
  $('#acBox').style.display = 'none';

  const input = ac.input;
  acClose();
  if (!input || !it) return;
  if (input.dataset.ac === 'vendor') {
    $('#docVendor').value = it.name;
    $('#docVendorAddress').value = vendorAddress(it);
    $('#docNPWP').value = it.npwp || '';
    if (it.block === 'X') showToast('Perhatian: vendor ini berstatus DIBLOKIR (Block MM) di master.', 'error');
  } else {
    const tr = input.closest('tr');
    input.value = it.name;
    tr.querySelector('.it-code').value = it.code || '';
    if (it.unit) tr.querySelector('.it-unit').value = it.unit;
    const price = tr.querySelector('.it-price');
    if (!Number(price.value) && it.price) price.value = it.price;
    recalcItems();
    tr.querySelector('.it-qty').focus();
  }
}

document.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
  const input = e.target;
  if (!input.dataset?.ac) return;
  clearTimeout(ac.timer);
  ac.timer = setTimeout(() => {
    ac.input = input;
    ac.idx = 0;
    ac.results = input.value.trim().length >= 2 ? acSearch(input.dataset.ac, input.value) : [];
    acRender();
  }, 120);
});

document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
  if (!ac.input || e.target !== ac.input || !ac.results.length) return;
  if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') { ac.idx = Math.min(ac.idx + 1, ac.results.length - 1); acRender(); e.preventDefault(); }
  else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') { ac.idx = Math.max(ac.idx - 1, 0); acRender(); e.preventDefault(); }
  else if (e.key === 'Enter') { acPick(ac.results[ac.idx]); e.preventDefault(); }
  else if (e.key === 'Escape') { acClose(); e.stopPropagation(); }
}, true);

document.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
  const item = e.target.closest?.('.ac-item');
  if (item) { e.preventDefault(); acPick(ac.results[Number(item.dataset.i)]); return; }
  if (e.target !== ac.input) acClose();
});

document.addEventListener('scroll', (e) => { if (ac.input && !e.target.closest?.('#acBox')) acRender(); }, true);

// ===== Penomoran =====
function generateDocNo(type, date, excludeId) {
  const d = date ? new Date(date + 'T00:00:00') : new Date();
  const year = d.getFullYear();
  const sameType = documents.filter(x => x.id !== excludeId && x.docType === type && (x.contractDate || '').startsWith(String(year)));
  const seq = sameType.length + 1;
  const code = settings.projectCode ? '/' + settings.projectCode : '';
  return `${pad(seq, 3)}/${type}${code}/${toRoman(d.getMonth() + 1)}/${year}`;
}

function suggestDocNo(force) {
  if (!force && $('#docNo').value.trim()) return;
  $('#docNo').value = generateDocNo($('#docType').value, $('#docContractDate').value, $('#docId').value);
}

// ===== Save =====
async function saveDocument(e) {
  e.preventDefault();
  const id = $('#docId').value;
  const file = $('#docFile').files[0];
  const items = getItemRows();

  if (items.length === 0) { showToast('Isi minimal 1 item / pekerjaan.', 'error'); return; }
  if (items.some(it => !it.desc)) { showToast('Uraian item tidak boleh kosong.', 'error'); return; }
  if (file && file.size > MAX_FILE) { showToast('Lampiran melebihi 10 MB.', 'error'); return; }

  const existing = id ? documents.find(d => d.id === id) : null;
  const now = Date.now();
  const doc = existing ? { ...existing } : { id: genId('d'), createdAt: now, attachmentData: null, attachmentName: null, attachmentType: null };

  Object.assign(doc, {
    project: $('#docProject').value.trim(),
    category: $('#docCategory').value,
    docType: $('#docType').value,
    docNo: $('#docNo').value.trim(),
    refNo: $('#docRefNo').value.trim(),
    vendor: $('#docVendor').value.trim(),
    vendorAddress: $('#docVendorAddress').value.trim(),
    npwp: $('#docNPWP').value.trim(),
    contractDate: $('#docContractDate').value,
    dueDate: $('#docDueDate').value,
    status: $('#docStatus').value,
    notes: $('#docNotes').value.trim(),
    items,
    ppnOn: $('#docPpnOn').checked,
    ppnRate: Number($('#docPpnRate').value) || 0,
    updates: getUpdateRows(),
    updatedAt: now,
  });
  if (!doc.docNo) doc.docNo = generateDocNo(doc.docType, doc.contractDate, doc.id);

  // Catat perubahan status & nilai otomatis di riwayat update
  if (existing) {
    const auto = [];
    if (existing.status !== doc.status) auto.push(`Status: ${existing.status} → ${doc.status}`);
    const before = docTotals(existing).total, after = docTotals(doc).total;
    if (before !== after) auto.push(`Nilai: ${formatIdp(before)} → ${formatIdp(after)}`);
    if (auto.length) doc.updates.push({ id: genId('u'), date: todayStr(), party: 'Lainnya', description: auto.join('; '), notes: 'otomatis' });
  }

  // Lampiran
  if ($('#removeAttachment')?.checked) {
    doc.attachmentData = doc.attachmentName = doc.attachmentType = null;
  }
  try {
    if (file) {
      doc.attachmentName = file.name;
      doc.attachmentType = file.type;
      doc.attachmentData = await readFileAsDataURL(file);
    }
    await dbPut(doc);
  } catch (err) {
    showToast('Gagal menyimpan: ' + err.message, 'error');
    return;
  }

  // Simpan vendor baru ke master otomatis
  if (doc.vendor && !masterData.vendors.some(v => (v.name || '').trim().toLowerCase() === doc.vendor.toLowerCase())) {
    const v = makeMasterItem('vendors', { name: doc.vendor, address: doc.vendorAddress, npwp: doc.npwp });
    masterData.vendors.push(v);
    await dbPutMasterItems([v]);
    renderMasterData();
  }

  closeModal();
  await render();
  showToast(existing ? 'Dokumen diperbarui.' : 'Dokumen tersimpan.');
}

function requireXLSX() {
  if (window.XLSX) return true;
  showToast('Library Excel belum termuat. Pastikan ada koneksi internet lalu muat ulang.', 'error');
  return false;
}

function exportRekapExcel() {
  closeMenu();
  if (!requireXLSX()) return;
  if (filteredDocs.length === 0) { showToast('Tidak ada dokumen untuk diexport.', 'error'); return; }
  const rekap = [['No', 'No. Dokumen', 'Tanggal', 'Tipe', 'Kategori', 'Proyek', 'Vendor', 'NPWP', 'No. Referensi',
    'Jatuh Tempo', 'Jumlah Item', 'Sub Total', 'PPN', 'Total', 'Status', 'Update Terakhir', 'Catatan']];
  const detail = [['No. Dokumen', 'Vendor', 'No', 'Kode', 'Uraian', 'Satuan', 'Volume', 'Harga Satuan', 'Jumlah']];
  const upd = [['No. Dokumen', 'Vendor', 'Tanggal', 'Jenis', 'Deskripsi', 'Catatan']];
  filteredDocs.forEach((d, i) => {
    const t = docTotals(d);
    const last = d.updates.slice().sort((a, b) => (b.date || '').localeCompare(a.date || ''))[0];
    rekap.push([i + 1, d.docNo, d.contractDate, getDocType(d.docType).label, getCategoryLabel(d.category), d.project, d.vendor,
      d.npwp, d.refNo || '', d.dueDate || '', d.items.length, t.sub, t.ppn, t.total, d.status,
      last ? `${last.date} ${last.party}: ${last.description}` : '', d.notes]);
    d.items.forEach((it, j) => detail.push([d.docNo, d.vendor, j + 1, it.code || '', it.desc, it.unit, it.qty, it.price, (Number(it.qty) || 0) * (Number(it.price) || 0)]));
    d.updates.forEach(u => upd.push([d.docNo, d.vendor, u.date, u.party, u.description, u.notes]));
  });
  const wb = XLSX.utils.book_new();
  XLSX.utils.book_append_sheet(wb, XLSX.utils.aoa_to_sheet(rekap), 'Rekap');
  XLSX.utils.book_append_sheet(wb, XLSX.utils.aoa_to_sheet(detail), 'Rincian Item');
  XLSX.utils.book_append_sheet(wb, XLSX.utils.aoa_to_sheet(upd), 'Riwayat Update');
  XLSX.writeFile(wb, `Rekap_Dokumen_JICT_${todayStr()}.xlsx`);
}

async function backupData() {
  closeMenu();
  const data = { app: 'JICT_Priuk_Kontrak', version: 3, exportedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    documents: await dbGetAll(), settings,
    master: Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(masterData).map(([k, list]) => [k, list.map(toDbItem)])) };
  const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(data)], { type: 'application/json' });
  const a = document.createElement('a');
  a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  a.download = `Backup_JICT_Kontrak_${todayStr()}.json`;
  a.click();
  setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href), 60000);
  showToast(`Backup ${data.documents.length} dokumen diunduh.`);
}

async function restoreData(input) {
  closeMenu();
  const file = input.files[0];
  input.value = '';
  if (!file) return;
  let data;
  try { data = JSON.parse(await file.text()); } catch { showToast('File backup tidak valid.', 'error'); return; }
  if (!data || !Array.isArray(data.documents)) { showToast('File backup tidak dikenali.', 'error'); return; }
  if (!confirm(`Restore ${data.documents.length} dokumen dari backup ${data.exportedAt || ''}?\n` +
    'Dokumen dengan ID sama akan ditimpa; master data & pengaturan diganti dari backup.')) return;
  for (const d of data.documents) {
    if (d && d.id) await dbPut(normalizeDoc(d));
  }
  if (data.master) {
    for (const type of Object.keys(MASTER_FIELDS)) {
      if (!Array.isArray(data.master[type])) continue;
      await dbDeleteMasterItems(masterData[type].map(x => x.uid));
      const items = data.master[type].filter(x => x && x.name)
        .map(x => makeMasterItem(type, { ...x, price: x.price ?? x.haran ?? x.estimateRate ?? '' }));
      await dbPutMasterItems(items);
    }
    await loadMasterData();
  }
  if (data.settings) { settings = { ...DEFAULT_SETTINGS, ...data.settings }; await dbPutSettings(settings); applySettingsUI(); }
  renderMasterData();
  await render();
  showToast('Restore selesai.');
}

  onMasterSearch.timer = setTimeout(() => { masterPage = 0; renderMasterData(); }, 200);
}

function changeMasterPage(delta) {
  masterPage += delta;
  renderMasterData();
}

function renderMasterData() {
  $('#countVendors').textContent = masterData.vendors.length.toLocaleString('id-ID');
  $('#countMaterials').textContent = masterData.materials.length.toLocaleString('id-ID');
  $('#countServices').textContent = masterData.services.length.toLocaleString('id-ID');

  const type = currentMasterTab;
  const cols = MASTER_FIELDS[type].filter(f => f.table);
  const tokens = ($('#masterSearch').value || '').trim().toLowerCase().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
  const rows = tokens.length
    ? masterData[type].filter(it => { const s = searchText(it); return tokens.every(t => s.includes(t)); })
    : masterData[type];

  const pages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(rows.length / MASTER_PAGE));
  masterPage = Math.min(Math.max(0, masterPage), pages - 1);
  const start = masterPage * MASTER_PAGE;
  const pageRows = rows.slice(start, start + MASTER_PAGE);

  $('#masterPager').innerHTML = rows.length
    ? `<span>${(start + 1).toLocaleString('id-ID')}–${(start + pageRows.length).toLocaleString('id-ID')} dari ${rows.length.toLocaleString('id-ID')} data</span>
       <button class="btn btn-sm" onclick="changeMasterPage(-1)" ${masterPage === 0 ? 'disabled' : ''}>◀ Sebelumnya</button>
       <span>Hal. ${masterPage + 1} / ${pages}</span>
       <button class="btn btn-sm" onclick="changeMasterPage(1)" ${masterPage >= pages - 1 ? 'disabled' : ''}>Berikutnya ▶</button>`
    : '';

  const tbody = $('#masterTbody');
  if (rows.length === 0) {
    tbody.innerHTML = `<div class="master-empty"><div class="empty-icon">📦</div><p>${tokens.length
      ? 'Tidak ada data yang cocok.'
      : `Master ${MASTER_LABEL[type]} masih kosong. Klik “📥 Import Excel” atau “+ Tambah”.`}</p></div>`;
    return;
  }
  tbody.innerHTML = `<div class="table-scroll"><table class="master-table"><thead><tr>
      <th style="width:44px;">No</th>${cols.map(f => `<th>${escapeHtml(f.label)}</th>`).join('')}<th style="width:120px;">Aksi</th></tr></thead><tbody>
      ${pageRows.map((it, i) => `<tr data-uid="${escapeHtml(it.uid)}" class="${it.block === 'X' ? 'row-blocked' : ''}" title="Klik dua kali untuk edit">
        <td class="c muted">${(start + i + 1).toLocaleString('id-ID')}</td>
        ${cols.map(f => {
          const v = it[f.key];
          if (f.type === 'number') return `<td class="num">${v !== '' && v !== undefined ? formatIdp(v) : '<span class="muted">—</span>'}</td>`;
          if (f.key === 'block') return `<td class="c">${v === 'X' ? '<span class="badge-block">Blokir</span>' : ''}</td>`;
          return `<td${f.key === 'name' ? ' class="strong"' : ''}>${escapeHtml(v)}</td>`;
        }).join('')}
        <td><div class="master-item-actions">
          <button class="btn btn-sm" data-act="edit">✏️ Edit</button>
          <button class="btn btn-sm btn-danger-ghost" data-act="del" title="Hapus">✕</button>
        </div></td></tr>`).join('')}
    </tbody></table></div>`;
}

function findMaster(uid) {
  return masterData[currentMasterTab].find(x => x.uid === uid);
}

function onMasterTableClick(e) {
  const btn = e.target.closest('button[data-act]');
  const tr = e.target.closest('tr[data-uid]');
  if (!btn || !tr) return;
  if (btn.dataset.act === 'edit') openMasterForm(tr.dataset.uid);
  else if (btn.dataset.act === 'del') removeMasterRow(tr.dataset.uid);
}

function onMasterTableDblClick(e) {
  const tr = e.target.closest('tr[data-uid]');
  if (tr && !e.target.closest('button')) openMasterForm(tr.dataset.uid);
}

function openMasterForm(uid) {
  const type = currentMasterTab;
  const item = uid ? findMaster(uid) : null;
  $('#masterFormTitle').textContent = (item ? '✏️ Edit ' : '+ Tambah ') + MASTER_LABEL[type];
  $('#masterUid').value = item ? item.uid : '';
  $('#masterFields').innerHTML = `<div class="form-grid">${MASTER_FIELDS[type].map(f => `
    <div class="form-group">
      <label for="mf_${f.key}">${escapeHtml(f.label)}${f.required ? ' *' : ''}</label>
      <input id="mf_${f.key}" type="${f.type === 'number' ? 'number' : 'text'}" ${f.type === 'number' ? 'min="0" step="any"' : ''}
        value="${escapeHtml(item ? item[f.key] ?? '' : '')}" ${f.required ? 'required' : ''}>
    </div>`).join('')}</div>`;
  openOverlay('#masterOverlay');
  $(item ? '#mf_name' : '#mf_code').focus();
}

function closeMasterForm() { closeOverlay('#masterOverlay'); }

async function saveMasterForm(e) {
  e.preventDefault();
  const type = currentMasterTab;
  const uid = $('#masterUid').value;
  const old = uid ? findMaster(uid) : null;
  const values = {};
  MASTER_FIELDS[type].forEach(f => { values[f.key] = $('#mf_' + f.key).value.trim(); });
  if (values.code && masterData[type].some(x => x.code === values.code && x.uid !== uid)) {
    showToast(`Kode ${values.code} sudah dipakai data lain.`, 'error');
    return;
  }
  const item = makeMasterItem(type, { ...values, uid: old?.uid });
  try {
    await dbPutMasterItems([item]);
  } catch (err) {
    showToast('Gagal menyimpan: ' + err.message, 'error');
    return;
  }
  if (old) masterData[type][masterData[type].indexOf(old)] = item;
  else masterData[type].unshift(item);
  closeMasterForm();
  renderMasterData();
  showToast(old ? 'Perubahan tersimpan.' : 'Data ditambahkan.');
}

async function removeMasterRow(uid) {
  const item = findMaster(uid);
  if (!item || !confirm(`Hapus "${item.name}"${item.code ? ' (' + item.code + ')' : ''}?`)) return;
  await dbDeleteMasterItems([uid]);
  masterData[currentMasterTab].splice(masterData[currentMasterTab].indexOf(item), 1);
  renderMasterData();
}

async function clearMasterData() {
  const type = currentMasterTab;
  const n = masterData[type].length;
  if (!n) return;
  if (!confirm(`Hapus SEMUA ${n.toLocaleString('id-ID')} data master ${MASTER_LABEL[type]}? Ini permanen.`)) return;
  await dbDeleteMasterItems(masterData[type].map(x => x.uid));
  masterData[type] = [];
  renderMasterData();
  showToast(`Master ${MASTER_LABEL[type]} dikosongkan.`);
}

function exportMasterData() {
  if (!requireXLSX()) return;
  const type = currentMasterTab;
  const fields = MASTER_FIELDS[type];
  const rows = masterData[type].map(it => fields.map(f => it[f.key] ?? ''));
  const wb = XLSX.utils.book_new();
  XLSX.utils.book_append_sheet(wb, XLSX.utils.aoa_to_sheet([fields.map(f => f.label), ...rows]), MASTER_LABEL[type]);
  XLSX.writeFile(wb, `master_${type}_${todayStr()}.xlsx`);
  if (!rows.length) showToast('Master masih kosong — file berisi template kolom saja.');
}

// ===== Import Excel =====
const SHEET_HINT = { vendors: ['vendor', 'rekanan'], materials: ['material'], services: ['service'] };
let importWb = null;      // workbook terbaca
let importRows = [];      // isi sheet terpilih (array of arrays)
let importHeaderIdx = 0;  // baris judul kolom

function normHeader(h) { return String(h ?? '').trim().toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, ' '); }

// Tebak kolom: cocok persis dulu, lalu yang mengandung kata kunci. Satu kolom hanya untuk satu field.
function guessMapping(type, headers) {
  const hs = headers.map(normHeader);
  const map = {}, used = new Set();
  for (const exact of [true, false]) {
    for (const f of MASTER_FIELDS[type]) {
      if (map[f.key] !== undefined) continue;
      for (const g of f.guess) {
        const idx = hs.findIndex((h, i) => h && !used.has(i) && (exact ? h === g : (g.length >= 4 && h.includes(g))));
        if (idx >= 0) { map[f.key] = idx; used.add(idx); break; }
      }
    }
  }
  return map;
}

function sheetHead(ws, n = 20) {
  if (!ws || !ws['!ref']) return [];
  const r = XLSX.utils.decode_range(ws['!ref']);
  r.e.r = Math.min(r.e.r, r.s.r + n - 1);
  r.e.c = Math.min(r.e.c, r.s.c + 80);
  return XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(ws, { header: 1, defval: '', range: r });
}

// Skor kecocokan (jenis data, sheet, baris judul) — dipakai untuk memilih otomatis
function scoreSheet(type, name, head) {
  let best = { score: 0, headerIdx: 0 };
  head.forEach((row, i) => {
    const m = guessMapping(type, row);
    if (m.name === undefined) return;
    const score = Object.keys(m).length;
    if (score > best.score) best = { score, headerIdx: i };
  });
  if (best.score >= 2 && SHEET_HINT[type].some(k => name.toLowerCase().includes(k))) best.score += 1.5;
  return best;
}

function openImportModal() {
  $('#importType').value = currentMasterTab;
  $('#importFile').value = '';
  $('#importReplace').checked = true;
  importWb = null;
  importRows = [];
  $('#importDetail').style.display = 'none';
  $('#importInfo').textContent = '';
  openOverlay('#importOverlay');
}

function closeImportModal() { closeOverlay('#importOverlay'); }

async function readImportFile() {
  const file = $('#importFile').files[0];
  importWb = null;
  importRows = [];
  $('#importDetail').style.display = 'none';
  if (!file) return;
  if (!requireXLSX()) return;
  $('#importInfo').textContent = `⏳ Membaca ${file.name} (${(file.size / 1048576).toFixed(1)} MB)…`;
  await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 30));
  try {
    importWb = XLSX.read(await file.arrayBuffer(), { type: 'array', cellFormula: false, cellHTML: false, cellText: false });
  } catch (err) {
    $('#importInfo').textContent = '';
    showToast('Gagal membaca file: ' + err.message, 'error');
    return;
  }

  // Pilih otomatis kombinasi jenis data + sheet yang paling cocok
  let best = null;
  const heads = Object.fromEntries(importWb.SheetNames.map(n => [n, sheetHead(importWb.Sheets[n])]));
  for (const type of Object.keys(MASTER_FIELDS)) {
    for (const n of importWb.SheetNames) {
      const s = scoreSheet(type, n, heads[n]);
      if (!best || s.score > best.score) best = { ...s, type, sheet: n };
    }
  }
  $('#importSheet').innerHTML = importWb.SheetNames.map(n => `<option>${escapeHtml(n)}</option>`).join('');
  if (best && best.score >= 2) {
    if (best.type !== $('#importType').value) {
      showToast(`Isi file terdeteksi sebagai master ${MASTER_LABEL[best.type]}.`);
      $('#importType').value = best.type;
    }
    $('#importSheet').value = best.sheet;
  }
  loadImportSheet();
}

function onImportTypeChange() {
  if (!importWb) return;
  const type = $('#importType').value;
  let best = null;
  importWb.SheetNames.forEach(n => {
    const s = scoreSheet(type, n, sheetHead(importWb.Sheets[n]));
    if (!best || s.score > best.score) best = { ...s, sheet: n };
  });
  if (best && best.score >= 2) $('#importSheet').value = best.sheet;
  loadImportSheet();
}

function loadImportSheet() {
  if (!importWb) return;
  const type = $('#importType').value;
  const name = $('#importSheet').value;
  const ws = importWb.Sheets[name];
  importRows = ws && ws['!ref'] ? XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(ws, { header: 1, defval: '', blankrows: false }) : [];
  importHeaderIdx = scoreSheet(type, name, importRows.slice(0, 20)).headerIdx;
  $('#importHeaderRow').value = importHeaderIdx + 1;
  buildMappings();
}

function onHeaderRowChange() {
  importHeaderIdx = Math.max(0, (Number($('#importHeaderRow').value) || 1) - 1);
  buildMappings();
}

function buildMappings() {
  if (!importWb) return;
  const type = $('#importType').value;
  const headers = (importRows[importHeaderIdx] || []).map(h => String(h ?? '').trim());
  const guess = guessMapping(type, headers);
  const options = headers.map((h, i) => `<option value="${i}">${escapeHtml(h || 'Kolom ' + XLSX.utils.encode_col(i))}</option>`).join('');
  $('#importMappings').innerHTML = MASTER_FIELDS[type].map(f => `
    <div class="map-row">
      <label>${escapeHtml(f.label)}${f.required ? ' *' : ''}</label>
      <select id="map_${f.key}" onchange="renderImportPreview()"><option value="">— tidak ada / abaikan —</option>${options}</select>
    </div>`).join('');
  MASTER_FIELDS[type].forEach(f => { if (guess[f.key] !== undefined) $('#map_' + f.key).value = guess[f.key]; });
  $('#importDetail').style.display = 'block';
  renderImportPreview();
}

function currentImportMap() {
  const map = {};
  MASTER_FIELDS[$('#importType').value].forEach(f => {
    const v = $('#map_' + f.key)?.value ?? '';
    if (v !== '') map[f.key] = Number(v);
  });
  return map;
}

function parseNumber(v) {
  if (typeof v === 'number') return v;
  const s = String(v ?? '').replace(/[^\d,.-]/g, '');
  if (!s) return '';
  const n = Number(/,\d{1,2}$/.test(s) ? s.replace(/\./g, '').replace(',', '.') : s.replace(/[.,](?=\d{3}(\D|$))/g, ''));
  return isFinite(n) ? n : '';
}

function rowToItem(type, row, map) {
  const src = {};
  MASTER_FIELDS[type].forEach(f => {
    const v = map[f.key] === undefined ? '' : row[map[f.key]];
    src[f.key] = f.type === 'number' ? parseNumber(v) : v;
  });
  if (src.price === 0) src.price = '';
  return makeMasterItem(type, src);
}

function renderImportPreview() {
  const type = $('#importType').value;
  const map = currentImportMap();
  const dataRows = importRows.slice(importHeaderIdx + 1).filter(r => map.name !== undefined && String(r[map.name] ?? '').trim());
  const cols = MASTER_FIELDS[type].filter(f => map[f.key] !== undefined);
  $('#importInfo').innerHTML = map.name === undefined
    ? '⚠️ Pilih kolom untuk <b>' + escapeHtml(MASTER_FIELDS[type].find(f => f.required).label) + '</b>.'
    : `✅ <b>${dataRows.length.toLocaleString('id-ID')}</b> baris data siap diimport dari sheet “${escapeHtml($('#importSheet').value)}”. Contoh 3 baris pertama:`;
  $('#importPreview').innerHTML = map.name === undefined ? '' : `<div class="table-scroll"><table class="master-table small">
    <thead><tr>${cols.map(f => `<th>${escapeHtml(f.label)}</th>`).join('')}</tr></thead>
    <tbody>${dataRows.slice(0, 3).map(r => { const it = rowToItem(type, r, map);
      return `<tr>${cols.map(f => `<td>${escapeHtml(f.type === 'number' && it[f.key] !== '' ? formatIdp(it[f.key]) : it[f.key])}</td>`).join('')}</tr>`; }).join('')}</tbody>
  </table></div>`;
}

async function doImport() {
  const type = $('#importType').value;
  if (!importWb) { showToast('Pilih file Excel terlebih dahulu.', 'error'); return; }
  const map = currentImportMap();
  if (map.name === undefined) { showToast('Kolom nama/deskripsi wajib dipilih.', 'error'); return; }

  // Susun item, buang duplikat dalam file (kunci: kode, atau nama bila kode kosong)
  const keyOf = (it) => it.code ? 'c:' + it.code : 'n:' + it.name.toLowerCase();
  const incoming = new Map();
  importRows.slice(importHeaderIdx + 1).forEach(r => {
    const it = rowToItem(type, r, map);
    if (it.name) incoming.set(keyOf(it), it);
  });
  if (!incoming.size) { showToast('Tidak ada data valid untuk diimport.', 'error'); return; }

  const replace = $('#importReplace').checked;
  const msg = replace
    ? `Ganti seluruh master ${MASTER_LABEL[type]} (${masterData[type].length.toLocaleString('id-ID')} data lama) dengan ${incoming.size.toLocaleString('id-ID')} data dari file?`
    : `Tambahkan/perbarui ${incoming.size.toLocaleString('id-ID')} data master ${MASTER_LABEL[type]}?`;
  if (!confirm(msg)) return;

  const btn = $('#btnDoImport');
  btn.disabled = true;
  btn.textContent = '⏳ Mengimport…';
  try {
    let added = 0, updated = 0;
    const toPut = [];
    if (replace) {
      await dbDeleteMasterItems(masterData[type].map(x => x.uid));
      masterData[type] = [];
      incoming.forEach(it => { toPut.push(it); added++; });
    } else {
      const existing = new Map(masterData[type].map(x => [keyOf(x), x]));
      incoming.forEach((it, k) => {
        const old = existing.get(k);
        if (old) {
          const merged = { ...old };
          MASTER_FIELDS[type].forEach(f => { if (it[f.key] !== '') merged[f.key] = it[f.key]; });
          delete merged._s;
          toPut.push(merged);
          updated++;
        } else {
          toPut.push(it);
          added++;
        }
      });
    }
    await dbPutMasterItems(toPut);
    await loadMasterData();
    closeImportModal();
    switchMasterTab(type);
    showToast(`Import selesai: ${added.toLocaleString('id-ID')} baru, ${updated.toLocaleString('id-ID')} diperbarui.`);
  } catch (err) {
    showToast('Import gagal: ' + err.message, 'error');
  } finally {
    btn.disabled = false;
    btn.textContent = '📥 Import';
  }
}


// ===== File handling =====
function readFileAsDataURL(file) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const fr = new FileReader();
    fr.onload = () => resolve(fr.result);
    fr.onerror = () => reject(fr.error);
    fr.readAsDataURL(file);
  });
}

// ===== Pembaruan Aplikasi (paket .json, tanpa mengganti file) =====
function updateDb(mode, fn) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const r = indexedDB.open(window.UPDATE_DB || 'JICT_Priuk_Pembaruan', 1);
    r.onupgradeneeded = () => r.result.createObjectStore('paket');
    r.onerror = () => reject(r.error);
    r.onsuccess = () => {
      const db = r.result;
      const tx = db.transaction('paket', mode);
      const req = fn(tx.objectStore('paket'));
      let result;
      req.onsuccess = () => { result = req.result; };
      tx.oncomplete = () => { db.close(); resolve(result); };
      tx.onerror = () => { db.close(); reject(tx.error); };
    };
  });
}
const updateGet = (key) => updateDb('readonly', s => s.get(key));
const updatePut = (key, v) => updateDb('readwrite', s => s.put(v, key));
const updateDel = (key) => updateDb('readwrite', s => s.delete(key));

function runningSource() {
  return window.PAKET_AKTIF ? `paket pembaruan (dipasang ${formatDateTime(window.PAKET_AKTIF.dipasang)})` : 'file bawaan di folder';
}

async function openUpdate() {
  closeMenu();
  const [aktif, sebelumnya] = await Promise.all([updateGet('aktif'), updateGet('sebelumnya')]).catch(() => [null, null]);
  const base = window.APP_BASE_VERSION || APP_VERSION;
  const ignored = aktif && !window.PAKET_AKTIF && window.bandingVersi?.(aktif.versi, base) <= 0;
  $('#updateInfo').innerHTML = `
    <table class="pv-meta">
      <tr><td>Versi berjalan</td><td>:</td><td><strong>${escapeHtml(APP_VERSION)}</strong> — ${escapeHtml(runningSource())}</td></tr>
      <tr><td>Versi file bawaan</td><td>:</td><td>${escapeHtml(base)}</td></tr>
      ${aktif ? `<tr><td>Paket tersimpan</td><td>:</td><td>${escapeHtml(aktif.versi)}${aktif.tanggal ? ' (' + escapeHtml(aktif.tanggal) + ')' : ''}${ignored ? ' — <em>diabaikan, file bawaan lebih baru</em>' : ''}</td></tr>` : ''}
      ${sebelumnya ? `<tr><td>Cadangan versi</td><td>:</td><td>${escapeHtml(sebelumnya.versi)}</td></tr>` : ''}
    </table>
    ${aktif?.catatan && !ignored ? `<div class="update-note">${escapeHtml(aktif.catatan)}</div>` : ''}
    ${/[?&]aman\b/.test(location.search) ? '<p class="text-danger">Mode aman: paket pembaruan tidak dijalankan.</p>' : ''}`;
  $('#btnRollback').style.display = aktif ? '' : 'none';
  $('#btnRollback').textContent = sebelumnya ? `↩️ Kembali ke ${sebelumnya.versi}` : `↩️ Kembali ke versi bawaan ${base}`;
  openOverlay('#updateOverlay');
}

async function installUpdate(input) {
  const file = input.files[0];
  input.value = '';
  if (!file) return;
  let pkg;
  try { pkg = JSON.parse(await file.text()); } catch { showToast('File pembaruan tidak valid (bukan JSON).', 'error'); return; }
  if (!pkg || pkg.format !== UPDATE_FORMAT || !pkg.versi || typeof pkg.js !== 'string' || !pkg.js.includes('APP_VERSION')) {
    showToast('File ini bukan paket pembaruan aplikasi JICT Kontrak.', 'error');
    return;
  }
  const cmp = window.bandingVersi ? window.bandingVersi(pkg.versi, APP_VERSION) : 1;
  const base = window.APP_BASE_VERSION || APP_VERSION;
  if (window.bandingVersi && window.bandingVersi(pkg.versi, base) <= 0) {
    showToast(`Versi ${pkg.versi} tidak lebih baru dari file bawaan ${base} — tidak perlu dipasang.`, 'error');
    return;
  }
  const head = cmp > 0 ? `Pasang pembaruan ${APP_VERSION} → ${pkg.versi}?`
    : `Versi ${pkg.versi} ${cmp === 0 ? 'sama dengan' : 'LEBIH LAMA dari'} versi berjalan ${APP_VERSION}. Tetap pasang?`;
  if (!confirm(`${head}\n\n${String(pkg.catatan || '').slice(0, 600)}\n\nData dokumen & master tidak berubah.`)) return;
  try {
    const aktif = await updateGet('aktif');
    if (aktif && aktif.versi !== pkg.versi) await updatePut('sebelumnya', aktif);
    await updatePut('aktif', { ...pkg, dipasang: Date.now() });
  } catch (err) {
    showToast('Gagal memasang pembaruan: ' + err.message, 'error');
    return;
  }
  showToast(`Pembaruan ${pkg.versi} terpasang. Memuat ulang…`);
  setTimeout(() => { location.href = location.pathname; }, 800);
}

async function rollbackUpdate() {
  const sebelumnya = await updateGet('sebelumnya');
  const target = sebelumnya ? sebelumnya.versi : `versi bawaan ${window.APP_BASE_VERSION || ''}`;
  if (!confirm(`Kembali ke ${target}? Data dokumen & master tidak berubah.`)) return;
  if (sebelumnya) {
    await updatePut('aktif', sebelumnya);
    await updateDel('sebelumnya');
  } else {

  }
  location.href = location.pathname;
}

const S = () => settings;

function angka(n, dec = 0) {
  const v = Number(n) || 0;
  const neg = v < 0;
  const fixed = Math.abs(v).toFixed(dec);
  const [int, frac] = fixed.split('.');
  const ribu = S().sepRibu === ',' ? ',' : '.';
  const desimal = ribu === '.' ? ',' : '.';
  const grup = int.replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, ribu);
  return (neg ? '-' : '') + grup + (frac ? desimal + frac : '');
}

function persen(v, dec = 2) {
  return angka((Number(v) || 0) * 100, dec) + '%';
}

function tglObj(s) {
  if (!s) return null;
  const d = new Date(s + 'T00:00:00');
  return isNaN(d) ? null : d;
}

function tglID(s) {
  const d = tglObj(s);
  return d ? `${pad(d.getDate())} ${BULAN[d.getMonth()]} ${d.getFullYear()}` : '';
}

function judulKata(s) {
  return String(s).replace(/\b\w/g, c => c.toUpperCase());
}

function bilang(n, milyar) {
  let t = judulKata(terbilang(Math.round(Math.abs(Number(n) || 0))));
  if (milyar) t = t.replace(/Miliar/g, 'Milyar');
  return (Number(n) < 0 ? 'Minus ' : '') + t + ' Rupiah';
}

function hariIni(s) {
  const d = tglObj(s);
  if (!d) return { hari: '', tgl: '', bulan: '', tahun: '' };
  return {
    hari: HARI[d.getDay()],
    tgl: judulKata(terbilang(d.getDate())),
    bulan: BULAN[d.getMonth()],
    tahun: judulKata(terbilang(d.getFullYear())),
    dd: pad(d.getDate()), mm: pad(d.getMonth() + 1), yyyy: d.getFullYear(),
  };
}

// Kalimat pembuka persis seperti master masing-masing
function kalimatBahan(s) {
  const h = hariIni(s);
  return `Pada hari ini ${h.hari}, tanggal ${h.tgl} bulan ${h.bulan} tahun ${h.tahun} (${h.dd}/${h.mm}/${h.yyyy})`;
}
function kalimatSubkon(s) {
  const h = hariIni(s);
  return `Pada hari ini ${h.hari} tanggal ${h.tgl} bulan ${h.bulan} tahun ${h.tahun} (${tglID(s)}), kami yang bertandatangan di bawah ini:`;
}
function kalimatAlat(s) {
  const h = hariIni(s);
  return `Pada hari ini ${h.hari} tanggal ${h.tgl} bulan ${h.bulan} tahun ${h.tahun} (${h.dd} - ${h.mm} - ${h.yyyy}), kami yang bertandatangan di bawah ini:`;
}

  const h = akhir ? hitung(k, akhir) : null;
  return { N, terminN: tr.length, prestasi: h ? h.pSd : 0, dibayar: h ? h.bap.sd : 0 };

// ===== Perhitungan (mengikuti rumus master) =====
const barisItem = (k) => (k.items || []).filter(it => (it.tipe || 'item') === 'item');

function nilaiKontrak(k) {
  return barisItem(k).reduce((s, it) => s + (Number(it.volume) || 0) * (Number(it.harga) || 0), 0);
}

function penandatangan(k) {
  // Master: penanda tangan BAP / Lampiran / BAPR = Kuasa KSO bila nilai kontrak ≥ batas
  const s = S();
  if (s.kuasaNama && nilaiKontrak(k) >= (Number(s.batasKuasa) || Infinity)) return { nama: s.kuasaNama, jabatan: s.kuasaJabatan };
  return { nama: s.pp1Nama, jabatan: s.pp1Jabatan };
}

function hitung(k, t) {
  const N = nilaiKontrak(k);
  const sebelum = terminKontrak(k.id).filter(x => x.ke < t.ke);
  const rows = (k.items || []).map(it => {
    if ((it.tipe || 'item') !== 'item') return { ...it };
    const vol = Number(it.volume) || 0, harga = Number(it.harga) || 0;
    const lalu = sebelum.reduce((s, x) => s + (Number(x.vol?.[it.uid]) || 0), 0);
    const saat = Number(t.vol?.[it.uid]) || 0;
    const sd = lalu + saat;
    const bobot = N ? vol * harga / N : 0;
    return {
      ...it, vol, harga, lalu, saat, sd, sisa: vol - sd, jml: vol * harga,
      jmlSaat: saat * harga, jmlSd: sd * harga, bobot,
      bLalu: vol ? lalu / vol * bobot : 0, bSaat: vol ? saat / vol * bobot : 0, bSd: vol ? sd / vol * bobot : 0,
    };
  });
  const items = rows.filter(r => (r.tipe || 'item') === 'item');
  const sum = (f) => items.reduce((s, r) => s + r[f], 0);
  const pSd = N ? sum('jmlSd') / N : 0;
  const pLalu = N ? items.reduce((s, r) => s + r.lalu * r.harga, 0) / N : 0;
  const pSaat = pSd - pLalu;
  const bap = { sd: Math.round(pSd * N), lalu: Math.round(pLalu * N) };
  bap.saat = bap.sd - bap.lalu;
  const ret = Number(t.retPct) || 0, um = Number(t.umPct) || 0;
  const pot = (p) => { const sd = Math.round(p * bap.sd), lalu = Math.round(p * bap.lalu); return { sd, lalu, saat: sd - lalu }; };
  const retensi = pot(ret), uangMuka = pot(um);
  const potLain = Number(t.potLain) || 0;
  const jumlah = Math.round(bap.saat - retensi.saat - uangMuka.saat - potLain);
  const ppn = Math.round(jumlah * (Number(k.ppn) || 0));
  return {
    N, rows, items, pSd, pLalu, pSaat, bap, ret, um, retensi, uangMuka, potLain, jumlah, ppn, total: jumlah + ppn,
    jmlSaat: sum('jmlSaat'), bobotLalu: sum('bLalu'), bobotSaat: sum('bSaat'), bobotSd: sum('bSd'),
  };
}

function hitungBapr(k, b) {
  const N = nilaiKontrak(k);
  const ret = Number(k.retensi) || 0;
  let kum = 0;
  const baris = terminKontrak(k.id).map(t => {
    const h = hitung(k, t);
    kum += h.bap.saat;
    return { t, saat: h.bap.saat, kum, prog: N ? kum / N : 0, retensi: Math.round(h.bap.saat * ret) };
  });
  const hutang = baris.reduce((s, x) => s + x.retensi, 0);
  const lalu = Number(b.dibayarLalu) || 0;
  const saatIni = hutang - lalu;
  const ppn = Math.floor(saatIni * (Number(k.ppn) || 0));
  return { N, ret, baris, hutang, lalu, saatIni, ppn, total: saatIni + ppn, pLalu: hutang ? lalu / hutang : 0 };
}

// ===== Mesin cetak (template dari master Excel) =====
function fmtSel(v, fmt) {
  if (v === undefined || v === null || v === '') return { t: '' };
  if (typeof v !== 'number') return { t: String(v) };
  if (!fmt || fmt === 'General' || fmt === '@') return { t: angka(v, Number.isInteger(v) ? 0 : 2), n: true };
  const sec = [];
  let cur = '', q = false;
  for (const ch of fmt) {
    if (ch === '"') q = !q;
    if (ch === ';' && !q) { sec.push(cur); cur = ''; } else cur += ch;
  }
  sec.push(cur);
  let s = v > 0 ? sec[0] : v < 0 ? (sec[1] ?? sec[0]) : (sec[2] ?? sec[0]);
  const isNegSec = v < 0 && sec[1] !== undefined;
  const bersih = s.replace(/\[[^\]]*\]/g, m => (/Rp/.test(m) ? '"Rp"' : ''));
  const rp = /"Rp"/.test(bersih);
  if (v === 0 && /"\s*-\s*"/.test(bersih)) return { t: '-', n: true, rp };
  const pct = bersih.includes('%');
  const dm = bersih.match(/0\.(0+)/);
  const dec = dm ? dm[1].length : 0;
  let x = pct ? v * 100 : v;
  let t = angka(isNegSec ? Math.abs(x) : x, dec) + (pct ? '%' : '');
  if (isNegSec && /\(/.test(bersih.replace(/_\(/g, ''))) t = '(' + t + ')';
  else if (isNegSec) t = '-' + t;
  return { t, n: true, rp };
}

const SKALA_HURUF = 0.95;
let cssTerpasang = false;
function pasangCssCetak() {
  if (cssTerpasang || !window.CETAK_TPL) return;
  const st = document.createElement('style');
  st.id = 'cssCetak';
  // Excel (GDI) merender huruf sedikit lebih sempit daripada browser; koreksi agar baris tidak terlipat lebih banyak dari master
  const skala = (css) => css.replace(/font-size:([\d.]+)pt/, (m, pt) => `font-size:${(pt * SKALA_HURUF).toFixed(2)}pt`);
  st.textContent = CETAK_TPL.css.map((c, i) => `table.xl td.x${i}{${skala(c)}}`).join('\n');
  document.head.appendChild(st);
  cssTerpasang = true;
}

function renderLembar(tplId, isi) {
  const T = CETAK_TPL.tpl[tplId];
  pasangCssCetak();
  const sel = isi.sel || {};
  const sisaSel = new Set(Object.keys(sel));
  const td = (c, nilai, fmt, extra = '') => {
    const f = fmtSel(nilai, c.n || fmt);
    let html = escapeHtml(f.t);
    if (f.rp) html = `<span class="acc"><span>Rp</span><span>${escapeHtml(f.t)}</span></span>`;
    const rata = f.n && !/text-align/.test(CETAK_TPL.css[c.s]) ? ' style="text-align:right"' : '';
    return `<td class="x${c.s}"${c.cs ? ` colspan="${c.cs}"` : ''}${c.rs ? ` rowspan="${c.rs}"` : ''}${rata}${extra}>${html}</td>`;
  };
  const baris = (row, nilaiDari) => `<tr style="height:${row.h}px">${row.c.map(c => {
    const huruf = T.L[c.i];
    const addr = huruf + row.r;
    const [ada, val] = nilaiDari(huruf, addr, c);
    return td(c, ada ? val : (c.a ? '' : c.v), c.n);
  }).join('')}</tr>`;
  const dariSel = (h, addr, c) => {
    if (addr in sel) { sisaSel.delete(addr); return [true, sel[addr]]; }
    return [false];
  };
  let html = T.head.map(r => baris(r, dariSel)).join('');
  if (Object.keys(T.proto).length) {
    for (const b of (isi.baris || [])) {
      const proto = T.proto[b.jenis] || T.proto.item;
      html += baris(proto, (h) => [true, b.sel[h] ?? '']);
    }
    const pad0 = T.proto.kosong || T.proto.item;
    for (let i = 0; i < (isi.pad ?? T.isi); i++) html += baris(pad0, () => [true, '']);
  }
  // baris kosong di ujung area cetak tidak ikut dicetak (mencegah halaman kosong)
  const tail = T.tail.slice();
  while (tail.length && tail[tail.length - 1].c.every(c => !c.a && (c.v === undefined || c.v === '') && !(T.L[c.i] + tail[tail.length - 1].r in sel))) tail.pop();
  html += tail.map(r => baris(r, dariSel)).join('');
  if (sisaSel.size && isi.cekSel !== false) console.warn(tplId, 'sel tidak ditemukan di template:', [...sisaSel]);

  const lebar = T.cols.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
  const [mt, mr, mb, ml] = T.margin.map(m => (Number(m) || 0) * 25.4);
  const kertas = T.orient === 'landscape' ? 297 : 210;
  const tinggi = T.orient === 'landscape' ? 210 : 297;
  const isiMm = kertas - ml - mr;
  // Skala sama dengan pengaturan halaman master: "Fit to page" (lebar, lalu tinggi) atau skala tetap (%),
  // tidak pernah melebihi lebar kertas
  const fit = T.fit || { page: true, w: 1, h: 0, scale: 100 };
  const pasLebar = (isiMm * 96 / 25.4) / lebar;
  const zoom = fit.page ? pasLebar : Math.min(pasLebar, (fit.scale || 100) / 100);
  const tinggiPx = (tinggi - mt - Math.max(mb, 10)) * 96 / 25.4;
  return {
    html: `<div class="lembar" style="width:${isiMm}mm">
      ${logoHtml('Logo<br><small>(opsional — 🖼️ Sisipkan Logo)</small>')}${kopHtml()}
      <div class="lembar-skala" data-zoom="${zoom.toFixed(4)}" data-fit-h="${fit.page ? fit.h : 0}" data-tinggi="${tinggiPx.toFixed(1)}" style="zoom:${zoom.toFixed(4)}"><table class="xl" style="width:${lebar}px"><colgroup>${T.cols.map(w => `<col style="width:${w}px">`).join('')}</colgroup><tbody>${html}</tbody></table></div>
    </div>`,
    page: { orient: T.orient, margin: [mt, mr, Math.max(mb, 10), ml] },
  };
}

function barisRincian(rows, peta, opsi = {}) {
  // peta: fungsi (jenis, row, nomor) → objek {Huruf: nilai}
  const out = [];
  let no = 0;
  for (const r of rows) {
    const jenis = r.tipe || 'item';
    if (jenis === 'judul' || jenis === 'kelompok') no = opsi.nomorLanjut ? no : 0;
    if (jenis === 'item') no++;
    out.push({ jenis, sel: peta(jenis, r, no) });
  }
  return out;
}

  });

}

function isiBapr(k, b, menu) {

    G21: k.nomor, L21: tglID(k.tanggal), G22: h.N, G23: tglID(k.tglMulai || k.tanggal), J23: tglID(k.tglAkhir),

    O38: h.hutang, K41: h.hutang, I41: 1, O41: h.hutang, I42: h.pLalu, K42: h.hutang, O42: h.lalu,
    I43: 1 - h.pLalu, K43: h.hutang, O43: h.saatIni, O44: h.ppn, O46: h.total,

  });
  else Object.assign(sel, {
    O34: h.hutang, K37: h.hutang, I37: 1, O37: h.hutang, I38: h.pLalu, K38: h.hutang, O38: h.lalu,

// Fit to page tinggi (Excel "Fit to N page(s) tall"): perkecil skala bila isi melebihi tinggi halaman
function sesuaikanTinggi() {
  $$('#printContent .lembar-skala').forEach(el => {
    const kop = el.parentElement.querySelector('.kop-surat');
    const n = Number(el.dataset.fitH) || (kop ? 1 : 0);
    if (!n) return;
    const z = Number(el.dataset.zoom);
    el.style.zoom = 1;
    const h = el.getBoundingClientRect().height;
    if (!h) { el.style.zoom = z; return; }
    const maks = Number(el.dataset.tinggi) * n - 2 - (kop ? kop.getBoundingClientRect().height : 0);
    el.style.zoom = Math.min(z, maks / h).toFixed(4);
  });
}

// ===== Surat perjanjian Word (isi template master) =====
// isian: [Nomor Kontrak …[..]…] (kop), [teks isian], dan titik-titik (… atau ....)
const POLA_ISIAN = /\[Perjanjian[^\[\]]*?Nomor:\s*[.…]+[^\s\]\[]*\[PGr\]\/\[Tahun\]\]?|\[Nomor Kontrak(?:[^\[\]]|\[[^\]]*\])*\]|\(\.{2,}-\.{2,}-20\.\.\)|\(?DD-MM-YYYY\)|\[[^\[\]\n]{1,160}\]|[.…]{4,}/g;

function bacaZip(b64) {
  const bin = atob(b64);
  const arr = new Uint8Array(bin.length);
  for (let i = 0; i < bin.length; i++) arr[i] = bin.charCodeAt(i);
  return XLSX.CFB.read(arr, { type: 'array' });
}

function bagianXml(zip) {
  return zip.FullPaths.map((p, i) => [p, i]).filter(([p]) => /word\/(document|header\d*|footer\d*)\.xml$/.test(p));
}

const dekode = (u8) => new TextDecoder('utf-8').decode(u8 instanceof Uint8Array ? u8 : new Uint8Array(u8));

// Ambil daftar isian (placeholder) per paragraf, tahan terhadap teks yang terpecah di beberapa run
function pindaiParagraf(xmlDoc, cb) {
  const W = 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main';
  // hanya teks milik paragraf ini (bukan paragraf bersarang di kotak teks) agar urutan isian konsisten
  const milik = (t, p) => { let n = t.parentNode; while (n && !(n.localName === 'p' && n.namespaceURI === W)) n = n.parentNode; return n === p; };
  for (const p of [...xmlDoc.getElementsByTagNameNS(W, 'p')]) {
    const ts = [...p.getElementsByTagNameNS(W, 't')].filter(t => milik(t, p));
    if (!ts.length) continue;
    const teks = ts.map(t => t.textContent).join('');
    if (!POLA_ISIAN.test(teks)) { POLA_ISIAN.lastIndex = 0; continue; }
    POLA_ISIAN.lastIndex = 0;
    cb(p, ts, teks);
  }
}

const cacheIsian = {};

function daftarIsian(jenis) {
  if (cacheIsian[jenis]) return cacheIsian[jenis];
  const tpl = window.SURAT_TPL?.[jenis];
  if (!tpl) return null;
  const zip = bacaZip(tpl.b64);
  const hasil = [];
  let n = 0;
  for (const [path, i] of bagianXml(zip)) {
    const doc = new DOMParser().parseFromString(dekode(zip.FileIndex[i].content), 'application/xml');
    pindaiParagraf(doc, (p, ts, teks) => {
      let m;
      while ((m = POLA_ISIAN.exec(teks))) {
        const key = `${path.split('/').pop()}:${n}`;
        n++;
        const sebelum = teks.slice(Math.max(0, m.index - 70), m.index);
        const sesudah = teks.slice(m.index + m[0].length, m.index + m[0].length + 30);
        if (!hasil.some(h => h.key === key)) hasil.push({ key, ph: m[0], sebelum, sesudah, bagian: path.includes('header') ? 'kop' : 'isi', i: hasil.length });
      }
    });
  }
  cacheIsian[jenis] = hasil;
  return hasil;
}

// Nilai otomatis dari data kontrak untuk isian yang dikenali
function isianOtomatis(k, it) {
  const nilai = isianOtomatisDasar(k, it);
  if (typeof nilai !== 'string' || !nilai) return nilai;
  // hindari kata ganda, mis. "Pengadaan …" + "Pengadaan Material …"
  const akhir = it.sebelum.trim().split(/\s+/).pop() || '';
  let hasil = nilai;
  if (akhir.length > 2 && hasil.toLowerCase().startsWith(akhir.toLowerCase() + ' ')) hasil = hasil.slice(akhir.length + 1);
  if (!it.ph.startsWith('[') && /[A-Za-z]$/.test(it.sebelum)) hasil = ' ' + hasil;   // "Pengadaan……" tanpa spasi
  return hasil;
}

function isianOtomatisDasar(k, it) {
  const v = k.vendor || {}, s = S(), N = nilaiKontrak(k), ppn = Math.round(N * (Number(k.ppn) || 0));
  const h = hariIni(k.tanggal);
  const ph = it.ph.toLowerCase(), seb = it.sebelum.toLowerCase().trim();
  const daftar = cacheIsian[JENIS_KONTRAK[k.jenis]?.surat] || [];
  const prev = daftar[it.i - 1], next = daftar[it.i + 1];
  if (/^\[nomor kontrak/.test(ph)) return k.nomor;
  const kop = it.ph.match(/^\[(Perjanjian[^\[\]]*?Nomor:)/);
  if (kop) return kop[1] + ' ' + k.nomor;
  if (/^\(\.+-\.+-20\.\.\)$|^\(?dd-mm-yyyy\)$/.test(ph)) return `(${h.dd}-${h.mm}-${h.yyyy})`;
  if (it.ph.startsWith('[')) {
    if (/^\[isi dengan nama|^\[diisi atas nama perorangan\]$/.test(ph)) return '';
    if (/^\[diisi nama kepala proyek\]$/.test(ph)) return s.pp1Nama || undefined;
    if (/^\[diisi jabatan penandatangan\]$/.test(ph) && prev && /kepala proyek/i.test(prev.ph)) return s.pp1Jabatan;
    if (/^\[alamat perusahaan\]$/.test(ph)) return v.alamat;
    if (/^\[nama hari\]$/.test(ph)) return h.hari;
    if (/^\[tanggal\]$/.test(ph)) return h.tgl;
    if (/^\[nama bulan\]$/.test(ph)) return h.bulan;
    if (/^\[tahun\]$/.test(ph)) return h.tahun;
    if (/nama perusahaan|diisi nama vendor|nama subkon|nama mandor/.test(ph)) return /diisi nama vendor/.test(ph) ? UP(v.nama) : v.nama;
    if (/nama proyek/.test(ph)) return s.proyek;
    if (/nama material|nama pengadaan|nama pekerjaan|nama alat/.test(ph)) return k.pekerjaan;
    if (/tempat ditandatangani/.test(ph)) return s.kota;
  } else {
    if (/nomor\s*:?$/.test(seb) && it.bagian === 'isi' && !/surat|no\.\s*$/.test(seb.slice(-25))) return k.nomor;
    if (/^tanggal\s*:?$/.test(seb.slice(-9).trim()) && seb.length < 12) return tglID(k.tanggal);
    if (/no\. po sap\s*:?$/.test(seb)) return k.noPO || undefined;
    if (/rp\.?\s*$/.test(seb) && /terbilang/.test(it.sesudah.toLowerCase())) return angka(N + ppn);
    if (/terbilang\s*:?$/.test(seb)) return bilang(N + ppn);
    if (/dari tanggal\s*$/.test(seb)) return tglID(k.tglMulai || k.tanggal);
    if (/sampai dengan tanggal\s*$/.test(seb)) return tglID(k.tglAkhir);
    if (/kantor bank\s*:?$/.test(seb)) return v.bank;
    if (/no\. rekening\s*:?$/.test(seb)) return v.rekening;
    if (/atas nama\s*:?$/.test(seb)) return v.namaRek || v.nama;
    if (/^pt\.?$/.test(seb) || /\bpt\.?\s*$/.test(seb) && seb.length < 6) return v.nama?.replace(/^PT\.?\s*/i, '');
    if (/^proyek$/.test(seb)) return s.proyek;
    if (/id proyek\s*:?$/.test(seb)) return s.kodeProyek;
    if (/(pengadaan|borongan pekerjaan)$/.test(seb) && seb.length < 32) return k.pekerjaan;
    if (/pada hari ini$/.test(seb)) return h.hari;
    if (/pada hari ini .* tanggal$/.test(seb)) return h.tgl;
    if (/pada hari ini .* bulan$/.test(seb)) return h.bulan;
    if (/pada hari ini .* tahun$/.test(seb)) return h.tahun;
    if (!seb && !it.sesudah.trim() && next && /atas nama perorangan/i.test(next.ph)) return v.nama;
    // baris titik-titik tunggal tepat di bawah nama pengadaan pada sampul → dikosongkan
    if (!seb && !it.sesudah.trim() && prev && /(pengadaan|borongan pekerjaan)\s*$/i.test(prev.sebelum)) return '';
  }
  return undefined;
}

function nilaiIsian(k, it) {
  const isian = k.isian?.[it.key];
  if (isian && isian.hapus) return '';
  if (isian && isian.v !== undefined && isian.v !== '') return isian.v;
  return isianOtomatis(k, it);
}

function isiDokumenWord(k) {
  const jenis = JENIS_KONTRAK[k.jenis].surat;
  const tpl = window.SURAT_TPL?.[jenis];
  const zip = bacaZip(tpl.b64);
  const daftar = daftarIsian(jenis);
  let n = 0;
  for (const [path, i] of bagianXml(zip)) {
    const entry = zip.FileIndex[i];
    const doc = new DOMParser().parseFromString(dekode(entry.content), 'application/xml');
    let ubah = false;
    pindaiParagraf(doc, (p, ts, teks) => {
      const ganti = [];
      let m;
      while ((m = POLA_ISIAN.exec(teks))) {
        const key = `${path.split('/').pop()}:${n}`;
        n++;
        const it = daftar.find(x => x.key === key);
        const val = it ? nilaiIsian(k, it) : undefined;
        if (val !== undefined) ganti.push({ a: m.index, b: m.index + m[0].length, val: String(val) });
      }
      // terapkan dari belakang agar posisi tetap valid
      for (const g of ganti.reverse()) {
        let pos = 0;
        let mulai = null;
        for (const t of ts) {
          const len = t.textContent.length, awal = pos, akhir = pos + len;
          if (akhir > g.a && awal < g.b) {
            const s0 = Math.max(g.a - awal, 0), s1 = Math.min(g.b - awal, len);
            const tx = t.textContent;
            if (mulai === null) { t.textContent = tx.slice(0, s0) + g.val + tx.slice(s1); mulai = t; }
            else t.textContent = tx.slice(0, s0) + tx.slice(s1);
            t.setAttributeNS('http://www.w3.org/XML/1998/namespace', 'xml:space', 'preserve');
          }
          pos = akhir;
        }
        ubah = true;
      }
    });
    if (ubah) entry.content = new TextEncoder().encode(new XMLSerializer().serializeToString(doc));
  }
  return XLSX.CFB.write(zip, { fileType: 'zip', type: 'array', compression: true });
}

function unduhSurat(kid) {
  const k = kontrakById(kid);
  const jenis = JENIS_KONTRAK[k.jenis]?.surat;
  if (!window.SURAT_TPL?.[jenis]) {
    showToast(`Template Word ${k.jenis} belum tersedia${k.jenis === 'SPPP' ? ' (file master SPPP terkunci/terenkripsi)' : ''}. Kirim master ${k.jenis} yang tidak terkunci.`, 'error');
    return;
  }
  if (!window.XLSX?.CFB) { showToast('Library pengolah file belum termuat.', 'error'); return; }
  try {
    const data = isiDokumenWord(k);
    const blob = new Blob([data], { type: 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document' });
    const a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    a.download = `${k.jenis}_${k.nomor.replace(/[\\/:*?"<>|]+/g, '-')}.docx`;
    a.click();
    setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href), 60000);
    showToast(`Surat ${k.jenis} diunduh — buka di Word untuk dicetak / simpan PDF.`);
  } catch (err) {
    console.error(err);
    showToast('Gagal membuat surat: ' + err.message, 'error');
  }
}

function ubahSyarat(a, el) {
  (formK.syarat ||= {})[a] = el.value;

}

function resetSyarat(a) {

      <td><input value="${escapeHtml(it.hargaKet || '')}" oninput="ubahBarisK(${i},'hargaKet',this.value)" ${isItem ? '' : 'disabled'} placeholder="include" title="Isi mis. 'include' bila harga sudah termasuk item lain"></td>

    </tr>`;

function ubahBarisK(i, f, val) {
  const it = formK.items[i];
  it[f] = ['volume', 'harga'].includes(f) ? (val === '' ? '' : Number(val)) : val;
  if (f === 'tipe') { renderBarisK(); return; }
  if (f === 'volume' || f === 'harga') {
    const tr = $(`#kItems tr[data-i="${i}"] .it-amount`);
    if (tr) tr.textContent = angka((Number(it.volume) || 0) * (Number(it.harga) || 0));
    hitungTotalK();
  }
}

function tambahBarisK(tipe) {
  formK.items.push({ uid: genId('i'), tipe, uraian: '', satuan: '', volume: '', harga: '' });
  renderBarisK();
  const rows = $$('#kItems tr');
  rows[rows.length - 1]?.querySelector('.it-desc')?.focus();
}

function hapusBarisK(i) {
  const it = formK.items[i];
  const dipakai = daftarTermin.some(t => t.kontrakId === formK.id && Number(t.vol?.[it.uid]));
  if (dipakai && !confirm('Item ini sudah memiliki progres di berita acara. Tetap hapus?')) return;
  formK.items.splice(i, 1);
  renderBarisK();
}

function geserBarisK(i, d) {
  const j = i + d;
  if (j < 0 || j >= formK.items.length) return;
  [formK.items[i], formK.items[j]] = [formK.items[j], formK.items[i]];
  renderBarisK();
}

function bacaFormKontrak(diam) {
  const k = formK;
  const val = (id) => ($('#' + id)?.value ?? '').trim();
  k.noUrut = pad(parseInt(val('kNoUrut'), 10) || 0);
  k.tanggal = val('kTanggal');
  k.status = $('#kStatusSel').value;
  k.pekerjaan = val('kPekerjaan');
  k.tglMulai = val('kMulai');
  k.tglAkhir = val('kAkhir');
  k.noPO = val('kPO');
  k.vendor = {
    nama: val('vNama'), npwp: val('vNpwp'), alamat: val('vAlamat'), direktur: val('vDirektur'), jabatan: val('vJabatan'),
    bank: val('vBank'), rekening: val('vRek'), namaRek: val('vNamaRek'),
  };
  k.ppn = (Number(val('kPpn')) || 0) / 100;
  k.tempo = Number(val('kTempo')) || 0;
  k.uangMuka = (Number(val('kUm')) || 0) / 100;
  k.retensi = (Number(val('kRet')) || 0) / 100;
  if ($('#kFranco')) { k.franco = val('kFranco'); k.keberterimaan = val('kTerima'); }
  k.addendum = { nomor: val('aNomor'), tanggal: val('aTanggal'), nilai: Number(val('aNilai')) || 0 };
  $$('#kIsian [data-k]').forEach(el => {
    const key = el.dataset.k;
    const hapus = $(`#kIsian [data-hapus="${CSS.escape(key)}"]`)?.checked;
    if (el.value.trim() || hapus) (k.isian ||= {})[key] = { v: el.value.trim(), hapus: !!hapus };
    else if (k.isian) delete k.isian[key];
  });
  k.nomor = nomorKontrak(k);
  if (diam) return [];
  const err = [];
  if (!k.noUrut || k.noUrut === '00') err.push('No. urut wajib diisi.');
  if (!k.tanggal) err.push('Tanggal kontrak wajib diisi.');
  if (!k.pekerjaan) err.push('Nama pekerjaan / pengadaan wajib diisi.');
  if (!k.tglMulai || !k.tglAkhir) err.push('Tanggal mulai dan akhir pelaksanaan wajib diisi.');
  else if (k.tglAkhir < k.tglMulai) err.push('Tanggal akhir tidak boleh sebelum tanggal mulai.');
  if (!k.vendor.nama || !k.vendor.alamat || !k.vendor.direktur) err.push('Nama, alamat, dan penanda tangan Pihak Kedua wajib diisi.');
  if (k.vendor.npwp && !/^[\d.\-\s]{15,22}$/.test(k.vendor.npwp)) err.push('Format NPWP tidak valid (15–16 digit).');
  const items = barisItem(k);
  if (!items.length) err.push('Minimal 1 baris item.');
  items.forEach((it, i) => {
    if (!it.uraian) err.push(`Item ke-${i + 1}: uraian wajib diisi.`);
    if (!(Number(it.volume) > 0) && !it.hargaKet) err.push(`Item "${it.uraian || i + 1}": volume harus > 0.`);
    if (Number(it.harga) < 0) err.push(`Item "${it.uraian || i + 1}": harga tidak boleh negatif.`);
  });
  if (k.ppn < 0 || k.ppn > 1 || k.uangMuka > 1 || k.retensi > 1) err.push('Persentase harus 0–100.');
  if (daftarKontrak.some(x => x.id !== k.id && x.nomor === k.nomor)) err.push(`Nomor ${k.nomor} sudah dipakai kontrak lain.`);
  return err;
}

async function simpanKontrak(e) {
  e.preventDefault();
  const err = bacaFormKontrak();
  if (err.length) { $('#kErr').innerHTML = err.map(escapeHtml).join('<br>'); $('#kErr').scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' }); return; }
  const k = formK;
  k.items = k.items.map(it => ({ ...it, volume: Number(it.volume) || 0, harga: Number(it.harga) || 0 }));
  const lama = kontrakById(k.id);
  k.createdAt = lama?.createdAt || Date.now();
  k.updatedAt = Date.now();
  await dbSimpan('kontrak', k);
  // vendor baru otomatis masuk master
  if (k.vendor.nama && !masterData.vendors.some(v => (v.name || '').trim().toLowerCase() === k.vendor.nama.toLowerCase())) {
    const v = makeMasterItem('vendors', { name: k.vendor.nama, address: k.vendor.alamat, npwp: k.vendor.npwp, direktur: k.vendor.direktur });
    masterData.vendors.push(v);
    await dbPutMasterItems([v]);
  }
  await muatModul();
  tutupForm();
  rute();
  showToast(`${k.jenis} ${k.nomor} tersimpan.`);
}

async function hapusKontrak(id) {

function gantiKontrakTermin(menu, kid) {

function pratinjauNomorT() {
  const k = kontrakById(formT.kontrakId);
  const ke = parseInt($('#tKe').value, 10) || formT.ke;

function renderItemT() {
  const k = kontrakById(formT.kontrakId);
  const h = hitung(k, { ...formT, ke: parseInt($('#tKe')?.value, 10) || formT.ke });
  $('#tItems').innerHTML = h.rows.map(r => {
    const t = r.tipe || 'item';

function ubahVolT(uid, val) {
  if (val === '') delete formT.vol[uid]; else formT.vol[uid] = Number(val);
  const k = kontrakById(formT.kontrakId);
  const h = hitung(k, { ...formT, ke: parseInt($('#tKe').value, 10) || formT.ke });
  const r = h.rows.find(x => x.uid === uid);
  const tr = $(`#tItems tr[data-uid="${uid}"]`);
  tr.querySelector('.t-sd').textContent = angka(r.sd, 2);
  const sisa = tr.querySelector('.t-sisa');
  sisa.textContent = angka(r.sisa, 2);

function isiSisaT() {
  const k = kontrakById(formT.kontrakId);

  h.items.forEach(r => { if (r.sisa > 0) formT.vol[r.uid] = Math.round(r.sisa * 1000) / 1000; });

  const k = kontrakById(formT.kontrakId);

}

  tampilCetak(tabs.includes(dariMenu) ? dariMenu : tabs[0], k, JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(formT)), 'preview', tabs);

function bacaFormTermin() {
  const k = kontrakById(formT.kontrakId);
  formT.ke = parseInt($('#tKe').value, 10) || 0;
  formT.tanggal = $('#tTanggal').value;
  formT.status = $('#tStatus').value;
  formT.periode = $('#tPeriode')?.value.trim() || '';
  formT.potLainKet = $('#tPotKet')?.value.trim() || '';
  hitungT();
  const err = [];
  if (formT.ke < 1) err.push('Termin ke- minimal 1.');
  if (terminKontrak(k.id).some(t => t.id !== formT.id && t.ke === formT.ke)) err.push(`Termin ${formT.ke} untuk kontrak ini sudah ada.`);
  if (!formT.tanggal) err.push('Tanggal berita acara wajib diisi.');
  else if (k.tanggal && formT.tanggal < k.tanggal) err.push('Tanggal berita acara tidak boleh sebelum tanggal kontrak.');
  const h = hitung(k, formT);
  if (!h.items.some(r => r.saat > 0)) err.push('Isi minimal 1 volume saat ini.');
  h.items.forEach(r => {
    if (r.saat < 0) err.push(`"${r.uraian}": volume tidak boleh negatif.`);
    if (r.sisa < -1e-9) err.push(`"${r.uraian}": volume s.d. saat ini (${angka(r.sd, 2)}) melebihi volume kontrak (${angka(r.vol, 2)}).`);
  });
  return { k, err };
}

async function simpanTermin(e) {

  const { err } = bacaFormTermin();
  if (err.length) { $('#tErr').innerHTML = err.map(escapeHtml).join('<br>'); return; }
  Object.keys(formT.vol).forEach(u => { if (!formT.vol[u]) delete formT.vol[u]; });
  formT.updatedAt = Date.now();
  formT.createdAt ||= Date.now();
  await dbSimpan('termin', formT);

  tutupForm();
  rute();
  showToast(`Termin ${formT.ke} tersimpan.`);
}

}

  tampilCetak(k.menu + '_bapr', k, { ...formT }, 'preview');
}

function bacaFormBapr() {
  const b = formT;
  b.kontrakId = $('#rKontrak').value;
  b.ke = parseInt($('#rKe').value, 10) || 0;
  b.tanggal = $('#rTanggal').value;
  b.status = $('#rStatus').value;
  b.nomorBast = $('#rBast').value.trim();
  b.tanggalBast = $('#rTglBast').value;
  b.dibayarLalu = Number($('#rLalu').value) || 0;
  const k = kontrakById(b.kontrakId);
  const err = [];
  if (b.ke < 1) err.push('BAPR ke- minimal 1.');
  if (!b.tanggal || !b.tanggalBast) err.push('Tanggal BAPR dan tanggal BAST wajib diisi.');
  else if (b.tanggal < b.tanggalBast) err.push('Tanggal BAPR tidak boleh sebelum BAST.');
  if (!terminKontrak(k.id).length) err.push('Kontrak ini belum memiliki BAP/termin.');
  if (!(Number(k.retensi) > 0)) err.push('Retensi kontrak 0% — tidak ada retensi untuk dibayarkan.');
  if (b.dibayarLalu > hitungBapr(k, b).hutang) err.push('Retensi dibayar sebelumnya melebihi total retensi.');
  return { k, err };
}

async function simpanBapr(e) {
  e.preventDefault();
  const b = formT;
  const { err } = bacaFormBapr();
  if (err.length) { $('#rErr').innerHTML = err.map(escapeHtml).join('<br>'); return; }
  b.updatedAt = Date.now();
  b.createdAt ||= Date.now();
  await dbSimpan('termin', b);
  await muatModul();
  tutupForm();
  rute();
  showToast('BAPR tersimpan.');
}

async function pilihLogo(input) {
  const f = input.files[0];
  if (!f) return;
  if (f.size > 1024 * 1024) { showToast('Ukuran logo maks. 1 MB.', 'error'); return; }
  settings.logo = await readFileAsDataURL(f);
  await dbPutSettings(settings);
  renderPengaturan();
  showToast('Logo tersimpan.');
}

async function pilihKop(input) {
  const f = input.files[0];
  if (!f) return;
  if (f.size > 2 * 1024 * 1024) { showToast('Ukuran kop maks. 2 MB.', 'error'); return; }
  settings.kop = await readFileAsDataURL(f);
  settings.pakaiKop = true;
  await dbPutSettings(settings);
  renderPengaturan();
  showToast('Kop surat tersimpan.');
}

async function aturKop(aktif, hapus) {
  settings.pakaiKop = aktif;
  if (hapus) settings.kop = '';
  await dbPutSettings(settings);
  renderPengaturan();
}

async function hapusLogo() {
  settings.logo = '';
  await dbPutSettings(settings);
  renderPengaturan();
}

async function simpanPengaturan(e) {
  e.preventDefault();
  const s = settings;
  Object.keys(PROYEK_DEFAULT).forEach(key => {
    const el = $('#set_' + key);
    if (!el || key === 'logo' || key === 'pin') return;
    s[key] = key === 'batasKuasa' ? Number(el.value) || 0 : el.value.trim();
  });
  const pin = { admin: $('#pinAdmin').value, user: $('#pinUser').value, viewer: $('#pinViewer').value };
  if ((pin.user || pin.viewer) && !pin.admin) { showToast('Isi PIN Admin terlebih dahulu.', 'error'); return; }
  if (pin.admin && pin.admin.length < 4) { showToast('PIN Admin minimal 4 karakter.', 'error'); return; }
  s.pin = pin;
  s.project = s.proyek;
  await dbPutSettings(s);
  applySettingsUI();
  showToast('Pengaturan tersimpan.');
  rute();
}
